data.title: Pronouns — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
It's a rainy morning, and we're stuck inside, but learning Spanish feels just right.

[Hook]
In the rain… En la lluvia
We're learning fast… Aprendemos rápido
Just you and I… Tú y yo
Let's take our time… Tomemos nuestro tiempo
We'll find our way.

[Verse]
Waking up, the world feels gray,
but we can learn and seize the day.
Myself… Yo mismo
Yourself… Tú mismo
We can say it in so many ways.
Ourselves… Nosotros mismos
Yourselves… Ustedes mismos
In the mirror, see yourself and say.
Himself/Herself/Itself… Sí mismo
Oneself… Uno mismo
These words will guide us through the fray.

[Hook]
In the rain… En la lluvia
We're learning fast… Aprendemos rápido
Just you and I… Tú y yo
Let's take our time… Tomemos nuestro tiempo
We'll find our way.

[Verse]
The rain taps softly on the pane,
while we explore this language game.
Yourselves (informal)… Vosotros mismos
With himself/with herself/with itself… Consigo mismo
In Spain or here, the words remain.
